run_uvicorn_server: run the uvicorn CLI server to host an ASGI application on the default host and port
run_uvicorn_with_reload: run the uvicorn server with auto-reload enabled to restart on code changes
run_uvicorn_with_workers: run the uvicorn server with multiple worker processes for concurrent request handling
run_uvicorn_ssl: run the uvicorn server with SSL/TLS certificates for secure HTTPS connections
run_uvicorn_unix_socket: run the uvicorn server bound to a UNIX domain socket instead of TCP
